# Milestone 1 report: automated visual grapheme extraction

**Every number below is measured on synthetic seals.** The test split is generated by the same program as the training data, so these scores show that the pipeline works on its own training distribution. They do not show that it works on real seals; see "Real photographs" below.

Test split: 400 synthetic seals, 1464 signs, never used for training, model selection or temperature tuning. Brackets are 95% bootstrap intervals over seals (1,000 resamples). No cross-validation was run: the data is generated, so a fresh held-out split replaces it.

## Detector comparison (end to end, same classifier)

| Metric | yolov8n | rtdetr-l | opencv |
|---|---|---|---|
| AP50 (single class) | 0.995 | 0.995 | n/a |
| AP50-95 (single class) | 0.972 | 0.980 | n/a |
| Detection precision (IoU 0.5) | 0.991 [0.985, 0.996] | 0.990 [0.985, 0.995] | 0.329 [0.280, 0.381] |
| Detection recall (IoU 0.5) | 0.999 [0.997, 1.000] | 0.999 [0.996, 1.000] | 0.458 [0.426, 0.492] |
| Recall on touching signs | 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] | 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] | 0.246 [0.193, 0.307] |
| Sign count correct | 0.973 [0.955, 0.988] | 0.963 [0.945, 0.980] | 0.135 [0.105, 0.168] |
| Top-1 sign ID on detected signs | 0.772 [0.747, 0.797] | 0.773 [0.749, 0.799] | 0.682 [0.646, 0.721] |
| Top-5 sign ID on detected signs | 0.939 [0.924, 0.954] | 0.943 [0.928, 0.958] | 0.870 [0.844, 0.896] |
| Sign error rate (edit distance / length) | 0.237 [0.211, 0.262] | 0.238 [0.210, 0.264] | 1.281 [1.110, 1.501] |
| Exact sequence match | 0.430 [0.383, 0.482] | 0.443 [0.393, 0.492] | 0.013 [0.003, 0.025] |
| Milliseconds per image, detector + classifier | 9 | 13 | 8 |

Timing device: `cuda`. Detections are kept at confidence 0.25 for every learned detector. "Touching signs" are ground-truth boxes that overlap a neighbour; this is the case the original PRD expected NMS to break.

## Classifier alone (ground-truth boxes, no detector)

| Signs, by frequency in the IM77 corpus | Test crops | Top-1 | Top-5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| all signs | 1464 | 0.789 [0.767, 0.808] | 0.949 [0.938, 0.960] |
| 50 most frequent signs | 611 | 0.887 [0.861, 0.910] | 0.992 [0.984, 0.998] |
| signs ranked 51-200 | 437 | 0.739 [0.698, 0.776] | 0.934 [0.908, 0.954] |
| rarer signs | 416 | 0.697 [0.654, 0.743] | 0.904 [0.875, 0.933] |

Intervals here resample crops. The reference bank and the test crops are both augmentations of the same 417 source drawings (IM-417 has one drawing per sign), so this measures robustness to the generator's distortions, not recognition of real carved signs. Per-sign precision, recall and F1 are in `per_class_f1.csv`.

## Real photographs

`figures/` holds each learned detector's output on the real seal photographs in `data/samples/`. There are no labelled real seals, so nothing here is scored. On the Mac run that preceded this report, a synthetic-trained YOLOv8n found the inscription area but merged neighbouring signs into one box and boxed the animal motif. Compare the figures from this run against that before relying on any detector.

## What is and is not delivered

- Delivered: synthetic generator, YOLOv8n and RT-DETR detectors, OpenCV baseline, DINOv2 nearest-neighbour sign classifier, image-to-sign-ID pipeline, this evaluation, training curves (`*_results.csv`, `*_results.png`).
- Not done: any measurement on real seals (needs labelled real photographs); Faster R-CNN (dropped: no expected gain over the two detectors compared here).
